name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
summary: In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden calls travelers to the Green Belt. He seeks help against threats that disturb the marsh's uneasy balance.

sections.title: Tending the Wounds
sections.body: Rethiel asks sympathetic travelers to ease the Wetlands' suffering. He urges them to hunt the destructive Mosshide gnolls that ravage wildlife and take the crude flints they use to burn the marsh's living trees. He also calls for the diseased fen creepers festering in the marsh waters to be thinned. Rethiel hopes these efforts will bring peace back to the wounded soil.

sections.title: Guardian of the Marsh
sections.body: Rethiel watches over the marsh from the damp thickets of the Green Belt. His towering form is made of moss, peat, and primal plant life. Unlike the bog beasts that wander the marsh as aggressive predators, Rethiel is conscious and speaks with sorrow. He feels the Wetlands as a living ecosystem, suffering under foreign predation and corruption.

faq.answer: Rethiel is a sentient bog beast in the Green Belt of the Wetlands. Unlike the mindless creatures of his kind, he speaks with mortals and protects the marsh.
Rethiel can be found in the Green Belt within the Wetlands, northeast of Dun Algaz.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want travelers to help him?
faq.answer: Rethiel senses the marsh suffering under invasive threats. He asks travelers to confront destructive Mosshide gnoll bands, take the crude flints they use to set marsh trees ablaze, and thin diseased fen creepers, bringing relief to the land.

faq.q: Are all bog beasts sentient like Rethiel?
faq.answer: Most bog beasts across Azeroth act on hostile instinct and lack higher intellect. Rethiel is exceptional: his deep natural attunement gives him sapience and speech.

faq.q: What threats does Rethiel focus on?
faq.answer: Rethiel focuses on curbing aggressive Mosshide gnolls, taking away their crude flints used to burn living wood, and purging diseased fen creepers festering in the marsh.

faq.q: Is Rethiel aligned with the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Rethiel is friendly to the Alliance and hostile to the Horde. He cares for the land and calls on Alliance travelers willing to mend the marsh.

angles.text: As a druid, you may recognize Rethiel as an unusual expression of Azeroth's wild balance. He speaks directly for a wounded ecosystem, much like the ancient protectors of Kalimdor.
As a shaman, you may sense Rethiel's attunement to the marsh's elemental and physical disharmony. He echoes the distress of the land itself as it groans under contamination and fire.
